title: Intracellular Cytokine Staining
author: Kristin Anderson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sqdeds6
materials: Prepare cocktail of antibodies for cell surface stain. Add 50-75uL of surface stain mix per well. Resuspend pellet by pipetting up + down at least 5x.
Prepare cocktail of antibodies in PWB buffer for Intracellular stain. Add 50-75uL of intracellular stain mix per well. Resuspend pellet by pipetting up + down at least 5x.

steps.title: Prepare cells and plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a flat‑bottom 96‑well plate. Resuspend cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells·mL⁻¹ in T‑cell media. Transfer at least 350 µL of cells per condition into a fresh tube (enough for ≥3 replicate wells of 100 µL each).

steps.title: Add Golgi Plug
steps.instruction: Dilute Golgi Plug 1:50 (stock 2 mg·mL⁻¹) directly into the cell suspension; after adding treatment the final Golgi Plug concentration will be 1:100 (1 mg·mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Prepare stimulant solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute PMA to a stock of 40 ng·mL⁻¹ so that the final assay concentration is 20 ng·mL⁻¹, and dilute Ionomycin to a stock of 2 mg·mL⁻¹ so that the final assay concentration is 1 mg·mL⁻¹; mix both in one tube of media. Resuspend peptide at 2 µg per 100 µL.

steps.title: Add stimuli and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of media alone, PMA/Ionomycin mixture, or peptide solution to each well. Incubate 4–6 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Transfer cells to U‑bottom plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the cells from the flat‑bottom plate into a U‑bottom 96‑well plate; combine replicate wells if cell numbers are low.

steps.title: Centrifuge and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 4 °C for 2 min at 809 × g with high brake; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Stain viability
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of Live/Dead stain per well (prepared by diluting 5 µL dye in 2.5 mL 1× DPBS). Incubate 20–30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash with FACS Buffer (first)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL FACS Buffer per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g high brake, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Incubate after first wash
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash with FACS Buffer (second)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL FACS Buffer per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g high brake, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with FACS Buffer (third)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL FACS Buffer per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g high brake, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with FACS Buffer (fourth)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL FACS Buffer per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g high brake, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Fixation/Permeabilization solution per well, resuspend pellet by pipetting up‑and‑down ≥5 times, incubate 20 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash with Perm/Wash Buffer (first series)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Perm/Wash Buffer (PWB) per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g with brake setting 2, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Perm/Wash Buffer (second series)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL PWB per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g brake 2, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Perm/Wash Buffer (third series)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL PWB per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g brake 2, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Incubate after perm washes
steps.instruction: Incubate plate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash with Perm/Wash Buffer (fourth series)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL PWB per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g brake 2, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Perm/Wash Buffer (fifth series)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL PWB per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g brake 2, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Perm/Wash Buffer (sixth series)
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL PWB per well, centrifuge 4 °C 2 min 809 × g brake 2, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in PFA and store
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 200 µL 0.5 % PFA (can leave overnight). Store at 4 °C; acquire on flow cytometer within 24 h for best results.
